changes.text: Fixed an issue where some huge or female head accessories did not fit correctly.
Removed Firefly and Snow Auras which were not intended for Issue 18. They will be available as part of Issue 19.
Fixed a bug that would cause players to lose attachments if they tried to claim them while their inventory was full.
Fixed out of date links for Going Rogue Complete Collection.
Mace Mastery – fixed availability of Focused Accuracy; the power was not unlocking properly.
Mace Mastery – fixed availability of Personal Force Field; the power was not unlocking properly
